Agent [agent.ts; retained by AgentSession]
|
|-- _state: MutableAgentState
|   |-- messages [live transcript; refreshed from canonical history]
|   |-- model / thinkingLevel [retained selection, not per-request routing]
|   |-- tools [callable implementations; installed by AgentSession]
|   `-- isStreaming / streamingMessage / pendingToolCalls / errorMessage
|-- steeringQueue + followUpQueue [two PendingMessageQueue instances]
|   |-- Each holds AgentMessage[] and mode: all / one-at-a-time
|   `-- createLoopConfig() supplies drain callbacks -> loop polling
|-- activeRun [present only during execution]
|   |-- AbortController -> signal passed to loop and listeners
|   `-- promise + resolve -> waitForIdle(); finishRun() resolves and clears
|-- listeners [Set; subscribe() returns removal closure]
|   `-- processEvents(): reduce _state first, then await each listener
|       `-- -> AgentSession handler: extension hooks, listeners, persistence
|-- Retained request callbacks and execution options
|   |-- SDK: convertToLlm / transformContext / streamFunction / provider hooks
|   |   `-- -> service-held ModelRuntime; current runner via mutable reference
|   |-- Session: prepareRequest / tool hooks / boundary + next-turn hooks
|   `-- sessionId / transport / budgets / retry delay / toolExecution / identity
`-- prompt()/continue() [methods; no retained loop instance]
    |-- createContextSnapshot() copies messages + callable tool arrays
    |-- createLoopConfig() captures selection, callbacks and queue access
    `-- runWithLifecycle() creates activeRun -> runAgentLoop*() functions
        `-- finishRun() clears streaming state after awaited event listeners
